note: ACME-212: a new Billing service in front of the payment provider, a plan column on users, the renewal job assumed retired

nodes.label: Billing
nodes.desc: Takes the upgrade from the web app, hands the charge to the payment provider and hears back when it is paid. Not built yet: this is the plan.

nodes.label: Billing service
nodes.desc: Two routes: Checkout starts the upgrade; Payment confirmed is what the provider calls back.

nodes.label: Renewal job
nodes.desc: Runs nightly. Bills annual plans that are due.
Postgres. The plan adds a plan column on users: free, annual, pro.

fact.text: 312 annual customers renew through this job

calls.text: Can we retire the renewal job?

dispute.says: Annual customers keep renewing through our job; new and upgraded customers bill through the provider.
dispute.chat: Updated the plan: the renewal job stays for annual customers.

calls.context: Pro will bill through the payment provider. The ticket says retire our renewal job, but annual customers still renew only through it.
calls.needs: Confirm to retire it, or Dispute to keep it
calls.assume: The renewal job can be retired.
calls.short: Annual customers still renew only through it.

calls.text: Should the renewal job skip anyone the provider bills?

confirm.chat: Duy confirmed: the renewal job skips anyone the provider bills. Added to the plan.

calls.context: An annual customer who upgrades to Pro would be billed twice: by the provider and by our renewal job.
calls.needs: Confirm the fix, or Dispute it
calls.assume: The renewal job will skip anyone the provider bills.
calls.short: Otherwise an annual customer who upgrades is billed twice.

answers.billing: Billing is the new service in the plan: Checkout starts an upgrade, the provider charges the card and calls Payment confirmed. The route must verify the sender and ignore repeats, or anyone could mark themselves paid.
